name: Lignum (Second Edition)

rounds.endCondition: Game ends after the second winter (8 seasons over 2 years), followed by a final sale

categories.label: Dollars after final sale
categories.hint: Dollars on hand after the final sale (sell all wood in sale/drying areas, plus all wood of one kind from the river). Dollars are victory points.

categories.label: Completed tasks (advanced/expert)
categories.labelVi: Nhiệm vụ hoàn thành (nâng cao/chuyên gia)
categories.hint: Dollars printed on each fully completed task card, paid at game end; incomplete tasks give nothing.

categories.label: Loan cards outstanding
categories.hint: Number of unreturned loan cards (0-2): pay 7 dollars for one, 16 dollars total for two.

notes: family: point-salad-euro (money-as-VP). Rulebook text consulted states only that the player with the most dollars wins; no tiebreaker found. Tasks apply only in the advanced and expert games (basic game has none). Loan repayment amounts taken from the rules summary; unverified against the printed Capstone rulebook PDF (BGG file download blocked), so needsReview. Joinery and Buildings expansion not modelled.

sources.title: Lignum rulebook summary (RulesPal)
sources.section: Game End - Final Sale; Loan Cards; Advanced Game (Tasks)
